sections.heading: Minimum System Requirements
sections.source_text:
macOS 14.6 or later
8GB of memory (16GB recommended)
Metal‑capable graphics card (Intel-based Mac computers only)
6.5GB of available disk space
Some features require macOS Sequoia and a Mac with Apple silicon. Some features require internet access; fees may apply.
https://www.apple.com/uk/final-cut-pro/specs/
